definition.heading: What is Liver Cancer?
definition.content: Liver cancer occurs when abnormal cells grow uncontrollably in the liver, an organ that processes nutrients and removes harmful substances from the blood. Alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) is a blood marker sometimes used to help monitor certain liver conditions.

actionable_insights.heading: Actionable Insights for Your Health
items: Avoid excessive alcohol consumption and maintain a healthy body weight.
Get checked for hepatitis B and C when recommended by your healthcare professional.
If you have chronic liver disease, discuss regular liver monitoring with your doctor, as AFP alone cannot diagnose cancer.
